description: This file contains partial class definitions and extension methods related to Orleans clustering and membership using ZooKeeper as the backend. It defines options classes for configuration, extension methods for integrating ZooKeeper clustering into Orleans clients and silos, and classes implementing membership table and gateway list provider functionalities.

classes.name: ZooKeeperClusteringSiloOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for a ZooKeeper-enabled silo in Orleans.

classes.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProviderOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the ZooKeeper gateway list provider.

classes.name: ZooKeeperHostingExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to integrate ZooKeeper clustering into Orleans client and silo builders.

classes.name: ZooKeeperBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements membership table operations using ZooKeeper backend for Orleans nodes.

classes.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Provides a list of gateway URIs for Orleans clients, backed by ZooKeeper.

methods.name: UseZooKeeperClustering
methods.description: Extension methods to add ZooKeeper clustering support to Orleans IClientBuilder and ISiloBuilder.
